bibliographic.title: Palace of Pantheon: Episode One
bibliographic.author: Asydien
bibliographic.description:
Palace of Pantheon is an adult interactive fiction exploring the complexities of polyamorous M/M relationships through branching narratives and psychological depth.

Watch Vex navigate relationships with Thorne (dominant intensity) and Felix (tender reverence) in a community where open relationships are normalized. Your choices determine whether these connections strengthen into sustainable love or gently separate into healing.

You are the eye that watches. Choose what you see.

CONTENT WARNING: Explicit sexual content (M/M), BDSM dynamics, power exchange, emotional intensity, and polyamorous relationships. All characters are adults, all activities are consensual.

Features:

- 8 distinct endings across multiple relationship configurations

- 120,000+ words of branching narrative across 140 passages

- Psychological depth and emotional realism

- Mature exploration of consent, communication, and compersion
